description: Turbo Evolution structural/algorithmic genes layered on top of the original parameter genome. Version 2 remains hash-compatible while widening enum alternatives.

genes.name: muster_topology
genes.description: Number/topology of independently gathering attack chunks, including dynamic topology.

genes.name: muster_anchor_policy
genes.description: Algorithm used to choose chunk anchors.

genes.name: chunk_transfer_policy
genes.description: Whether harvest/launch moves transfer the full movable stack, split it, or decide dynamically.

genes.name: defense_policy
genes.description: Threat-response algorithm: intercept choke, reinforce general, or adapt to ETA.

genes.name: fallback_policy
genes.description: Ordering algorithm used when the strategic scheduler has no candidate.

genes.name: picker_start_policy
genes.description: Algorithm used to select among viable edge-picker sweeps.
